notes.title: Discover "The Light of the Darkness: Origins" with our Game Director!
notes.notes:
🌟 Fans of Renascence! 🌟

We have something special happening on the Origins page that you won’t want to miss! Our Game Director, Fernando Rabello, is live, sharing secrets and exclusive insights about the universe of "The Light of the Darkness."

🔗 Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2490890/The_Light_of_the_Darkness_Origins/]Origins[/url] Page Now to Watch!

notes.title: Dive into 'The Light of the Darkness' Lore!
notes.notes:
🎉 We're thrilled to share our introductory lore guide for "The Light of the Darkness" universe, now accessible on [b]“The Light of the Darkness: Origins”[/b] game Community Hub. This guide provides a broad overview of the universe and its key elements, laying the groundwork for our [b]upcoming game[/b].

But that's just the beginning! In the coming weeks and months, we'll be releasing bite-sized sections that delve deeper into specific subjects, including character arcs, regions, cities, the idiom, mythology, the pervasive role of Essence in society's fabric, and much more.

Moreover, we want our community to co-create the Lore. Your feedback and suggestions will play a vital role in shaping the narrative and expanding the depth of our universe.

These releases will be informed by your feedback and requests, ensuring that we cover the topics that matter most to you. So, join us on this journey of exploration and discovery as we unravel the secrets of the Origins tale together.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2490890/The_Light_of_the_Darkness_Origins/]Wishlist[/url] the game, spread the word and invite fellow gamers to join our community! Your support helps us grow and create an even better experience for everyone. Thank you for being part of our journey!

🔍 Keep Exploring,

QUARTOMUNDO Team. 🚀

notes.title: Special Invitation to Our Renascence Wishlisters!
notes.notes:
We have some thrilling news for those of you who have followed us through "The Light of the Darkness: Renascence" and are craving more lore and excitement from our Fantasy Universe. 🌌

🔥 Introducing "The Light of the Darkness: Origins" 🔥 - a unique tale that dives deep into the lore’s tales and characters. This game is not a prelude; it's a whole new adventure seen through a different lens, rich with intrigue and the classic dark fantasy vibe that you’ve come to expect from "Renascence."

👀 Why Add "Origins" to Your Wishlist?

[list]
[*] Available Now:  There will be an amazing DEMO available during our showcase at the[b] Steam Next Fest on June 10[/b]
[*] Exclusive Content: Get a glimpse of the events and secrets that led to the conflicts in "Renascence."
[*] Deep Dive into Lore: Learn more about the characters and settings, including characters, places, and Sansico, the language especially crafted for our universe. (Lore’s Guide available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese).
[*] Special Offers and Updates: Wishlist now and be the first to receive exclusive updates and offers leading up to our Early Access in October 2024, and the Launch in December 2024.
[/list]
🚀 Join us on this new adventure! By adding "Origins" to your wishlist, you not only secure early information on game updates and exclusive content but also support us in creating experiences that you love.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2490890/The_Light_of_the_Darkness_Origins/] Wishlist "The Light of the Darkness: Origins" on Steam [/url] and be part of the saga from the very beginning!
